description: Kernel Panic is a team of 2  [B.E / CS / Engineering] students from Atria Institute of Technology. This is our first time at the NASA Space Apps Challenge. What brings us together is a love of space, technology and solving problems. Our team covers coding, research, design and presentation, which lets us look at challenges from every angle. We came to learn, work together and build something that uses NASA's data to help people and the planet.
